name: search-circle-dashed
description: A dashed circle containing a complete magnifying glass.
useCase: Find or inspect a draft item.
misuse: Describe the actual status in text; a dashed border alone does not define it.

16.reason: The complete lens and handle sit slightly inward to clear the full dashed frame at text size.

24.reason: The full frame and complete status marks retain the same centered layout with larger clear gaps.
